speaker: Away Fan
content:
ALRIGHT, listen up everyone, ESPECIALLY YOU, HOME FAN! First of all, your so-called effective execution was NOTHING MORE than good fortune! The ball landing right where Mbappe was waiting? That's not STRATEGY, that's LUCK! And what about the controversial penalty?! That was an OUTRIGHT GIFT to PSG from the referee!

And let me remind you: INTER scored the FIRST goal, placing PSG on the defensive right from the start! Does that sound like a team without effective execution to you?

I can also talk numbers, mate! Did you watch the same match as the rest of us? Because it seems like you missed the 60% BALL POSSESSION by Inter! Or the fact that WE had 10 SHOTS ON GOAL compared to PSG's 6?! And you STILL think PSG dominated? That's just LAUGHABLE!

As for Lukaku, he took on Marquinhos and Kimpembe HEAD ON! He kept fighting, never backing down, even when the odds were against him! That's a TRUE WARRIOR, showing more HEART and COURAGE than any PSG player on the field!

So, before you start spouting off about "champions", remember this: INTER FIGHTS till the last whistle, and we're PROUD of our team no matter what! AMALA INTER!!!
